# Gulf Coast HAZWOPER

> HAZWOPER training for Gulf Coast refinery, petrochemical and terminal workers: 40-hour, incident command, gas detection, manufacturing ERT and oil spill response, plus turnaround and benzene guides.

Gulf Coast HAZWOPER (https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40-Hour HAZWOPER, Incident Command, Gas Detection, Plant ERT or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER Training](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour HAZWOPER for plant cleanup, tank and waste work. Enroll: https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=587
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER (q) Incident Command Training](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training): $179.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Incident command for plant shift supervisors and ERT leaders. Enroll: https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-q-incident-command-training?buy=593
- [OSHA Air Monitoring and Gas Detection Training](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training): $49.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120 / 1910.146 / 1910.1000. Multi-gas meters and PIDs for H2S, LEL, benzene screening and oxygen. Enroll: https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-air-monitoring-and-gas-detection-training?buy=1056
- [Manufacturing Emergency Response Team (ERT) Training](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/manufacturing-emergency-response-team-ert-training): $149.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(q). Training for in-plant emergency response team members. Enroll: https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/manufacturing-emergency-response-team-ert-training?buy=702
- [OSHA 40 Hour HAZWOPER for Oil & Gas Spill Response](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-oil-and-gas-spill-response): $249.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e) / 1926.65(e). The 40-hour HAZWOPER for terminal and dock spill response. Enroll: https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-40-hour-hazwoper-for-oil-and-gas-spill-response?buy=591
- [OSHA 8 Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 29 CFR 1910.120(e)(8). The annual 8-hour refresher. Enroll: https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/courses/osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=595

## Guides

- [Turnaround season: getting contractor crews HAZWOPER-ready](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/guides/turnaround-season-hazwoper): Turnarounds bring hundreds of contractors on site at once. Training paperwork is the first bottleneck.
- [Benzene at refineries and chemical plants](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/guides/benzene-at-refineries): Benzene has its own OSHA standard with lower limits than most chemicals. What workers should know.
- [Plant emergency response: ERTs, mutual aid and HAZWOPER (q)](https://gulf-coast.hazwoperosha.us/guides/plant-emergency-response-gulf-coast): How Gulf Coast plants staff emergency response, and the training each role needs.
